BDB459 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB461

אֱלִישָׁפָט proper name, masculine (God has judged, Phoenician בעלשפט, שפטבעל) a captain in the time of Jehoiada 2Chr 23:1.

אֱלִיָּתָה see אֱלִיאָתָה.

אֶלְמוֺדָד see below I. אַל.
